description: This file contains a class 'LiteLLMResponsesTransformationHandler' that handles transforming API requests and responses between /chat/completions and litellm.responses formats, including response parsing, request transformation, and streaming response handling. It also defines a stream iterator class for processing streaming responses from the Responses API into OpenAI format.

classes.name: LiteLLMResponsesTransformationHandler
classes.description: Handles transforming requests and responses between /chat/completions API format and litellm.responses format, including response parsing, request building, and streaming response conversion.

classes.name: OpenAiResponsesToChatCompletionStreamIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for processing streaming responses from the Responses API and converting them into OpenAI chat completion streaming format.

methods.name: _handle_raw_dict_response_item
methods.description: Handles raw dictionary response items from the Responses API, converting them into Choices objects or skipping.

methods.name: convert_chat_completion_messages_to_responses_api
methods.description: Converts a list of messages into the Responses API input format.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Builds a Responses API request from chat messages and parameters.

methods.name: _convert_response_output_to_choices
methods.description: Converts Responses API output items into chat completion Choices objects.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Transforms a Responses API response into a chat completion response, including choices and usage.

methods.name: get_model_response_iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for streaming responses, converting to OpenAI format.

methods.name: _convert_content_str_to_input_text
methods.description: Converts a string content to a dictionary with type 'input_text' or 'output_text' based on role.

methods.name: _convert_content_to_responses_format_image
methods.description: Converts image content to Responses API input image parameter.

methods.name: _convert_content_to_responses_format
methods.description: Converts chat completion content to Responses API format, handling multimodal content.

methods.name: _convert_tools_to_responses_format
methods.description: Converts chat completion tools to Responses API tools format.

methods.name: _extract_extra_body_params
methods.description: Extracts and separates extra body parameters from optional parameters.

methods.name: _map_reasoning_effort
methods.description: Maps reasoning effort string or dict to a Reasoning object.

methods.name: _transform_response_format_to_text_format
methods.description: Transforms chat completion response_format to Responses API text.format.

methods.name: _map_responses_status_to_finish_reason
methods.description: Maps Responses API status to chat completion finish_reason.
